report: The Future of Free Speech, Trolls, Anonymity and Fake News Online
publisher: Pew Research Center and Elon University's Imagining the Internet Center

entries.label: Online discourse shaped by bad actors
entries.quote: In the next decade, will public discourse online become more or less shaped by bad actors, harassment, trolls, and an overall tone of griping, distrust, and disgust?
entries.subject: online harassment and trolling
entries.note: majority_view compares 'more shaped' with 'less shaped' only; the most common answer was 'no major change'.
entries.answer_mapping: agree = more shaped by negative activities; disagree = less shaped

notes: One question from a canvassing of eight questions fielded 2016-07-01 to 2016-08-12. The question asks about 'the next decade' / 'the next 10 years' and names no year; target_year 2026 is read from that horizon (the jobs report itself says 'by 2026'). Non-random opt-in canvassing.
